```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use App\Models\NoteTag;

class NoteShowComponent extends Component
{
    public $noteId;
    public $noteTags = [];

    protected function mount($noteId)
    {
        $this->noteId = $noteId;
        $this->noteTags = NoteTag::where('note_id', $this->noteId)->get();
    }

    public function saveTag()
    {
        $tagText = $this->input('tag_text');
        if (!empty($tagText)) {
            $newTag = new NoteTag([
                'user_id' => Auth::id(),
                'note_id' => $this->noteId,
                'text' => $tagText,
            ]);
            $newTag->save();
            $this->noteTags[] = $newTag;
        }
    }

    public function deleteTag(NoteTag $tag)
    {
        $tag->delete();
        $this->noteTags = NoteTag::where('note_id', $this->noteId)->get();
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.note-show-component');
    }
}
```
